## Overview

After the Great Sacrifice, the remaining Originals — **A** and **C** — subdivided themselves into lesser celestial beings (the gods). This was a strategic choice: B's sacrifice gave mortals magic, so direct destruction was no longer viable. The gods needed **control through worship, elimination through proxy**.

By splitting into many gods, A and C could: manage mortals through religion, harvest faith (which strengthens them), create division among mortals, and act from shadows.

---

## What the Gods ARE

The gods ARE fragments of A and C. A and C subdivided themselves into 10 entities. The amount of power B's sacrifice gave to the world — the ability to bend reality distributed across every living mortal across all planes — is equivalent to the power A and C gave to the gods, but concentrated and condensed in only 10 beings instead of spread across all mortal races and planes.

The gods are not original beings. They are **created beings**, subdivided from the two Originals who wanted genocide. They are not the top of the hierarchy.

---

## What the Gods CAN Do

- **Create, transform, and destroy NON-LIVING things** — they need raw matter to rearrange or turn into other things
- **Create LIVING things** — they can create new life from raw matter
- **CANNOT alter or destroy living things** — this is a fundamental limitation

### How This Works With Divine Actions

| Action | What Actually Happens |
|--------|----------------------|
| **Divine curse** | Creation of a non-living construct applied to a person. The curse itself is a created thing, not an alteration of the person. |
| **"Blessings"** | The god does nothing — they pretend to lend power. The mortal's own faith and arcane spark produce any perceived effect. |
| **Healing** | The god creates living tissue — growing back an arm, regenerating cells to close a wound. This is creation, not alteration. |
| **Resurrection** | The god creates a path (a non-living conduit) from the plane where the soul resides back to the body. |

---

## What the Gods CANNOT Do

- **Give powers to mortals** — this is the cornerstone of the False Firmament. A god cannot transfer their power to a mortal. Every "divine" spell cast by a cleric or paladin comes from the mortal themselves.
- **Alter a living being's fundamental nature** — they cannot change what a living creature is
- **Destroy a living being directly** — they must work through proxies and created forces

---

## How Divine Power Works

### Power Depletion

Each god received a vast but **LIMITED** amount of power when A/C subdivided. This power **DEPLETES** over time as they use it to create and affect reality. The more power a god loses, the less they can create, the less they can affect reality in each plane.

A god can eventually **DISAPPEAR** from reality entirely if they grow too weak.

### Worship as Fuel

Prayer, faith, and worship from mortals **RESTORES** their power — the arcane energy inside the mortal is transferred to the god. This extends their lifespan and can make them stronger.

This is the **entire reason the False Firmament exists**: trick mortals into worshiping to fuel the gods' continued existence.

### The Deeper Motivation for the Invasion

The monster invasion was not just genocide — it was a **power play**. The gods needed an expanded worship base and tighter control over mortal populations to maximize their faith harvest. Genocide through overwhelming force would concentrate survivors under divine rule, ensuring an endless supply of worship to sustain their existence.

---

## B's Sacrifice and the Balance of Reality

B's sacrifice gave mortals independent access to magic. This offset the balance of reality — before B's sacrifice, only A and C held genuine power over creation. B's act distributed power beyond the Originals for the first time, creating the **Weave** as a permanent, independent magical field available to all living beings.

The power B dispersed across all mortals and planes is equivalent to the power A and C concentrated into the 10 gods — but spread across billions of beings instead of 10. This is why mortals, collectively, could theoretically challenge the gods.

---

## Divine Magic — The Truth

The true source of a paladin's or cleric's magic is the **mortal caster themselves**. The god merely weaves their arcane signature into the magic the mortal manifests — then lies to mortals, claiming the powers are god-given.

### The Mechanism

- **The mortal's inner spark** is the source (every living being has arcane energy from B's sacrifice)
- **The Weave** is the flame (the permeating field of magical energy available to all)
- **Spell components** are fuel (many are fragments of B's physical remains)
- **The god's signature** is just branding — it makes the magic FEEL divine
- **The god claims credit** for magic the mortal performed themselves

### Why It Works

Prayer is the mechanism by which the mortal invites the god's participation in shaping their own innate weave access. This keeps mortals dependent on gods for what they could access themselves. Because the source is mortal, divine magic was not limited by B's protective shield — even during the 100 years when A, C, and the gods themselves could not interfere directly with the planes.

### Ki — Independent Proof

Ki is the ability to harness the inner arcane spark **without external components**. Monasteries know Ki comes from within, not from any god — independent proof that the divine magic system is a lie and that mortals can access magic without divine intermediaries.

---

## The Monster Invasion

~**400 years ago**, the gods enacted genocide by proxy, unable to destroy mortals directly.

### The Planar Pact
All ten gods knew and approved the plan, but only four personally negotiated — each matched to a plane by domain affinity:
- **Vorn** (War) -> **Nine Hells** — souls + power for infernal hierarchy
- **Lolth** (Trickery) -> **Abyss** — souls for demonic chaos
- **Aloria** (Life) -> **Feywild** — territory + power for fey beasts
- **Raven Queen** (Death) -> **Shadowfell** — territory for shadow-beasts and shadar-kai

The other six (Kaelthor, Aurelius, Vesper, Thalkis, Crassian, Tyra) were aware and approved but had no natural domain alignment with any of the four planes.

### The Breaches
Planar breaches opened along Kythoria's entire coast. Monster hordes poured forth — **The Abominable End** began. The monster army was not told why they invaded.

### Dual-Purpose Strategy
1. **Genocide through overwhelming force** — crush mortals decisively
2. **Strengthen worship through fear** — more fear -> more worship -> more power for the gods

### The Breaches Sealed
As reconquering pushed toward breach sources, gods sealed them to hide involvement. Breaches are gone; remaining monsters are those already on Kythoria.

### Silencing the Truth
Arcanists studying seal locations are uncovering the truth. The gods **quietly dispatch paladins/clerics** to silence these researchers — an active plot hook.

### B's Lingering Will
The gods did not anticipate B's subconscious desire to become whole again. This **hoarding instinct** drove monsters to hoard treasure instead of pursuing genocide — fracturing the invasion from within. **The gods have since discovered this**, creating a two-front problem: mortals resist AND monsters are corrupted away from mission.

### The New Directive
The gods now command religious orders to destroy:
- **Hoarding monster nests**
- **Large accumulations of magic items, currency metals, crystals**
- **Crimson Covenant operatives** (researching the resurrection ritual)

Official justification: strategic threat. True reason: fear of B's resurrection — hidden even from the devout.

## The Blackmail Standoff

ViF holds a magical contingency artifact — designed by the coalition's original founders. All 7 Convocation representatives must perform a daily check-in to reset it. If not reset daily, it broadcasts the truth about the Divine Conspiracy to every mortal across all planes.

This protects ALL 7 ViF member organizations equally. The gods cannot destroy any single member without risking universal exposure. See `the_divine_conspiracy.md` and `veritas_in_fractum.md` for full details.

## The Race Claims

Each god falsely claims to have created a specific mortal race. Full mapping in `races_and_ancestries.md`:

| God | Claims | Why It Fits the Lie |
|-----|--------|---------------------|
| Aloria | Humans | Most populous |
| Thalkis | Dwarves | Master crafters |
| Kaelthor | Elves | Long-lived, nature-attuned |
| Aurelius | Gnomes | Scholars, wisdom-keepers |
| Crassian | Halflings | Lucky traders |
| Vesper | Genasi | Children of thresholds |
| Lolth | Drow | Convenient lie — already worshipped |
| Raven Queen | Shadow Elves | Watchers at death's edge |
| Vorn | Half-Orcs | Conquering children |
| Tyra | Dragonborn | Perfect hunters |

In truth, no god created any race. The Originals created all mortal life. The Crimson Covenant produced Drow, Shadow Elves, and Tieflings.

---

## The Public Creation Myth (The Lie)

The gods fabricated a creation story omitting the Originals entirely. Calendar months follow this order:

1. **Kaelthor** — shaped world, planes, nature from chaos
2. **Aurelius** — imposed laws and order upon nature
3. **Vesper** — introduced peace, harmony, boundaries between states
4. **Aloria** — brought light and reproduction
5. **Tyra** — instilled hunger, survival instinct
6. **Raven Queen** — completed the cycle with death and mourning
7. **Thalkis** — taught forge and arcane knowledge
8. **Crassian** — introduced currency and trade
9. **Vorn** — granted ability to wage war and conquer
10. **Lolth** — provided wit and cunning to avoid conflict

> **Truth:** None happened. A, B, C created all existence. The gods fabricated this narrative.

---

## The Fake War — Three Scapegoats

The gods maintain an elaborate pantheon conflict (rivalries, schisms, holy wars) — all manufactured to deepen faith. Only the gods know it is theater.

Three gods publicly blamed for the invasion:

| God | Domains | Why Blamed | Church Status |
|-----|---------|------------|---------------|
| **Lolth** | Trickery & War | Deception + war — easy to blame. Drow never joined First Alliance. | **Banned** — Coven of the Spider cannot operate openly |
| **Raven Queen** | Death & Grave | Death follows invasion. Shadow Elves fled to Shadowfell. | **Banned** — Order of the Raven cannot operate openly |
| **Vorn** | War & Conquest | War god — invasion was an act of war. Half-Orcs DID fight in First Alliance. | **Officially banned** — Iron Host underground. Half-Orc worship secret. |

The other seven gods secretly coordinate with the three banned ones. Banned churches operate in shadows (Underdark, Shadowfell, hidden cells).

---

## The Ongoing Plan

The gods' long-term strategy:
- **Through religion** — control via worship, commandments, divine displeasure
- **Through deception** — hiding truth about Originals, magic, invasion, B's will, resurrection ritual
- **Through hoard destruction** — religious orders destroying hoards and accumulations
- **Through accumulated power** — amassing faith as a weapon to sustain their depleting power
- **Through fear** — remaining monsters ensure fear never fades, worship never ceases

An assured, crushing victory remains their goal — but B's will, ViF's blackmail artifact, and the resurrection threat complicate everything.
